summary.intent: Fix ultraplan session creation failures caused by git tree corruption, reduce 14GB bundle size using LFS, harden the repo against future issues, and ensure Claude bash access works in headless/subprocess sessions.
summary.outcome: Fixed git tree corruption (157 bad trees → 0), reduced bundle size from 14GB to 588MB via LFS migration and history rewriting, scrubbed exposed secrets from all history, resolved headless bash access by disabling CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB, and deployed a 5-tier health sentinel across Claude/Gemini/Pi platforms.

repo: Entire.io 'carry forward: uncommitted session files' commits absolute paths (e.g. /home/mike-anderson/.claude/plans/) outside the repo root, creating empty-filename tree entries that corrupt git objects in a way that git filter cannot bypass — must delete the offending branch entirely
1,048 entire/ shadow branches accumulated in ~5 weeks; Entire.io docs say these should stay local-only and never be pushed to remote — git push --all was silently pushing them
git lfs migrate import creates thousands of refs/replace/ refs that prevent GC from reclaiming old blobs; must delete them with git update-ref -d before repack succeeds
repack -Ad does not prune unreachable objects when replace refs exist; the workaround is: bundle → clone from bundle → swap .git/objects/ directories

CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 in settings.json strips sandbox-required env vars from subprocess Claude sessions, breaking bash access for all headless/subagent invocations — setting it to '0' fixes this
settings.json schema errors (e.g. statusLine missing required type and command fields) cause the entire file to be silently skipped, disabling all hooks, permissions, and env vars
shared_gemini.html was a saved copy of Gemini web UI containing Google's embedded API keys — triggered GitHub secret scanning; should never be committed
hookify plugin and large skill lists (200+ skills) intercept /ultraplan before the built-in CLI command handler runs; reducing to 6 essential plugins restores built-in command priority
package.json was a 0-byte empty file, causing Pi extension ESM resolution to fail with 'Invalid package config' error

code.finding: Log injection vulnerability: f-string with user input passed to logger. Fixed by using %s parameterized logging style so user input is treated as data, not format string.

workflow: git filter-repo --replace-text is the correct tool to scrub secrets from all history; create a replacements file with literal:REDACTED entries per token

GitHub secret scanning alerts do not auto-close when secrets are scrubbed from history — must explicitly resolve via gh api PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/secret-scanning/alerts/{number} -f state=resolved
git bundle create --all is what ultraplan uses; with GitHub connected, ultraplan clones from GitHub directly (no bundle size limit), but bundle must still succeed as fallback
entire clean --all --dry-run is the proper cleanup path for Entire.io orphaned branches; should be run monthly or when entire/ count exceeds 200
Pre-push hooks that call git lfs push --all origin will auto-upload LFS objects during normal pushes, eliminating the need for a separate lfs push step
Force-push deny rules in settings.json block even deliberate/authorized force-pushes — must temporarily remove the deny rule, push, then restore it
Bundle round-trip (create bundle → clone from bundle → copy objects/) is a reliable way to get a clean object store when repack fails to prune unreachable objects
SessionStart hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json fire at the beginning of every Claude Code session and are the right place for repo health checks, settings validation, and platform sentinel runs

friction: Force-push deny rules in settings.json required manual editing to temporarily allow deliberate force-pushes, even after explicit user permission was granted verbally
git repack -Ad silently kept 14GB of 'unreachable' blobs because refs/replace/ refs kept them reachable — required discovering the replace refs indirectly
GitHub secret scanning blocked the push even after the secret was redacted from HEAD, requiring a full history rewrite pass with filter-repo
Ultraplan /ultraplan command silently routed to the skill system (returning 'Unknown skill') instead of the CLI built-in handler due to plugin interference — no clear error indicating plugin conflict
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was silently breaking all headless/subagent bash access with no obvious error message linking it to that setting
LFS migration (git lfs migrate import) rewrote 5,876 commits but also re-expanded the bundle size from 182MB back to 588-724MB due to text replacement passes in filter-repo
Entire.io hasDotgit error prevented pushing 3 auto-generated checkpoint branches that had embedded .git directories in their carry-forward commits
open_items: CodeQL high-severity log injection alert in forge.py:114 — fixed in HEAD but awaiting next CodeQL scheduled scan to auto-close the alert

Weekly cron job for 'entire clean --all' and sentinel --heal expires after 7 days (Claude Code session limitation) — needs a permanent GitHub Actions scheduled workflow or systemd timer for persistence
28 remaining informational code scanning alerts not yet triaged
Branch protection ruleset 'main-protection' exists but has 0 rules — no required reviews, no status checks, PRs can merge without CI passing
Dependabot vulnerability scanning is still disabled
3 stale Entire.io branches remain on GitHub remote (deleted locally) — will age out but could be manually deleted via GitHub UI
Repo is PUBLIC on GitHub — 546MB publicly visible including vault notes and competition code; decision to make private was deferred

SurrealDB and Obsidian vault sync steps from the retrospective protocol were skipped (Steps 4, 8 in the retrospective) — learnings only propagated to markdown files, not to SurrealDB prompt_artifacts table or vault
graph_health() / Graph HIHO score was never computed — retrospective Step 8 graph registration and bidirectional_linker connections were not completed
Pi agent extensions cohezion-kg.ts and cohezion-kg-optimized.ts — the full repair sequence from PI_AGENT_REPAIR_GUIDE.md was not executed, only the package.json fix was applied
